PublicRemarks: This quick move-in home is already under construction and will be available in October. This Rose home offers an open concept first floor where the kitchen, breakfast area, and great room come together in a comfortable, connected layout, with a convenient powder room and valet located just off the garage for everyday ease. A covered patio at the rear provides a relaxing outdoor space to enjoy. Upstairs, all bedrooms are near one another, including the primary suite, creating a private and functional second level. An irrigation system is also included.
